name: decomposition_lee_smc_depth_matched
purpose: The decomposition on a DEPTH-MATCHED subsample. The arms are equalised on depth by construction, so a surviving difference in the mature fraction cannot be a depth difference.
method: harness.depth_confound.match_arm_depth: depth binned on pooled quantiles, each bin keeps min(n_normal, n_tumour) per arm. No threshold to choose.
cohort: GSE132465 (Lee SMC), 10 matched patients. Tier-A genes only in this run — the cached expression carried tier A; the full 9-gene unmatched run is results/2026-08-28_033cd51/.
cells: 1,616 of 6,372 scored epithelial cells retained (75% discarded).
headline: GUCA2A intrinsic -26.32, band [-79.7, -16.4], EXCLUDES zero and is unmoved by matching (-25.68 unmatched). Compositional -4.07, band [-23.4, +5.0], CONTAINS zero and shrinks 30%.
compositional_zero_is_not_absence: The compositional band is 28 points wide on ten patients. That is non-identifiability — the same finding G4 returned — not evidence that the compositional component is zero.
cost: Half the estimable rows degrade: at lineage, 36 ok / 0 wide / 4 not_estimable becomes 16 / 16 / 8. On this cohort a comparison can be clean or estimable, not both.
gap_check: lineage gap +25.1% unmatched -> +20.4% matched; best4 +5.7% -> +5.7% (never confounded). Per patient median delta -0.184, negative in 7 of 10 — suggestive only, binomial p ~ 0.17.
